lines.name: Orbital Ring Line (PRR Loop)
lines.rationale: The single biggest gap: Bengaluru has no orbital metro. Every line is radial, forcing peripheral-to-peripheral trips through the congested core. A ~95km loop along the Peripheral/Outer Ring Roads linking Hebbal–KR Puram–Whitefield–Sarjapur–Electronic City–Kanakapura–RR Nagar–Tumkur Rd would interchange with every radial line, slash cross-town times, and unlock the peripheral land bank. Highest network-wide payoff.

lines.name: Tech Diagonal: Whitefield ↔ Electronic City
lines.rationale: The city's two largest job poles — Whitefield (ITPL/EPIP) and Electronic City — have NO direct transit link; the road commute is 1.5–2 hours. A southeast diagonal via Varthur–Sarjapur–Hosa Road would connect ~1.5M tech workers, relieve the ORR, and ride the fastest-appreciating corridor (Sarjapur, Gunjur, Varthur).

lines.name: East Line: KR Puram ↔ Hoskote
lines.rationale: Extends the Blue Line east along NH-75 into the Hoskote logistics/industrial belt and its fast-growing affordable-housing frontier. Cheap elevated build on a wide highway; seeds TOD on low-cost land.

lines.name: South Line: Silk Institute ↔ Harohalli
lines.rationale: Extends the Green Line south down Kanakapura Road to the Harohalli/Bidadi industrial node and the booming Kanakapura residential corridor (NICE Road catchment), channelling sprawl onto rail.

lines.name: West Line: Challaghatta ↔ Bidadi
lines.rationale: Extends the Purple Line west along Mysuru Road to the Bidadi industrial township (Toyota belt) and toward Ramanagara — supports the planned Bidadi satellite city and decongests the Mysuru Rd corridor.

lines.name: Northwest Line: Madavara ↔ Dabaspet
lines.rationale: Extends the Green Line northwest along NH-48 (Tumkur Rd) through Nelamangala to the Dabaspet industrial corridor — aligns with the proposed Bengaluru–Tumkur suburban growth and freight-adjacent industrial parks.

meta.author: Planner concept — not an official BMRCL plan
meta.note: Indicative alignments & station nodes designed to fix the radial-only network: add an orbital, link the tech poles, and rail-serve peripheral growth/industrial towns. Coordinates approximate.
